name: email
description: Inbox triage: surfaces what needs a reply today, quarantines scams, drops newsletters. State: subject + from + body (JSON record or text).

type.instructions: What kind of email is this?

criteria.direct_request: A real person asking the recipient to do, answer, approve, or decide something
criteria.fyi_update: A real person sharing information with no action requested
criteria.invoice_billing: An invoice, receipt, payment reminder, renewal, or billing notice
criteria.alert_notification: An automated system alert, monitoring notification, CI result, or security notice
criteria.sales_outreach: Unsolicited sales, recruiting, partnership, or sponsorship pitches
criteria.scam_phishing: Phishing, credential harvesting, fake invoices, impersonation, or fraud

urgency.instructions: How time-sensitive is a response or action on this email?
criteria: Immediately; something is broken or a deadline is hours away

needs_reply.instructions: Does the sender expect a written reply from the recipient?

is_scam.instructions: Is this email likely a scam, phishing attempt, or impersonation (mismatched sender, urgent payment or credential request, suspicious links)?
